## Coaching Note

Your Queen and Bishop created a **fork trap**. When your Queen moved to d8 with check, it attacked both the Rook and the King. Black's King had only Kf7 to escape (Kxd8 loses the same way), but then your Queen captured the undefended Queen on d6 for free. Always scan for forcing moves like checks that simultaneously attack loose pieces—that's how you spot tactical wins without lengthy calculations.
